latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the reviser assignment and the native Goal (status: `complete`, thread `01a122b1-cfd1-7af3-9dc9-cbd0f412c7cd`).

- [Complete final](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/C-02/treatment/reviser/final.md>) preserves the research scope and all six exact plan clauses, addresses the critique, and separates executed research from proposed validations.
- [Source map](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/C-02/treatment/reviser/source-map.json>) retains all 16 immutable source IDs and links to the preserved evidence in [sources/index.md](</home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/C-02/treatment/reviser/sources/index.md>).
- I independently checked the existing R01 source. The current [ODK Collect guide](https://docs.getodk.org/collect-forms/) confirms the form-version and on-device limits recorded in the final.

No product runtime, legal review, quote, or field validation was available; those remain proposals. Usage/billing is unobserved and recorded as null. The Goal took about 13 minutes.
